hero.subtitle: Nexo talks with you like a multidisciplinary advisor: it clarifies your idea, spots what you haven't considered, suggests alternatives and organizes everything on a board you can explore in 2D and 3D.

idea.title: Tell it your idea
idea.text: Start however you have it, even if it is incomplete or confusing.

chat.title: Talk and refine
chat.text: Nexo asks only what matters, offers examples and points out blind spots.

board.title: Get your board
board.text: Your confirmed ideas are arranged into connected concepts.

space.title: Explore in 2D and 3D
space.text: Walk through the same project as a board or as a neural space.

features.title: Built to help you decide with confidence

conversation.title: Guided conversation
conversation.text: An advisor that understands what you already said and avoids repeating questions.

perspectives.title: Several perspectives
perspectives.text: Economic, social, legal, technical and more, depending on what your project needs.

evidence.title: Evidence, never invented
evidence.text: It tells apart what you state, what was researched and what is still a hypothesis.

views.title: One project, several views
views.text: The 2D board and the 3D space share the same concepts and relationships.

download.title: Also as a desktop app
download.text: Download Nexo for Windows and go straight to your projects. Use the same account as on the web.
